faq.question: Does TikTok Shop replace Amazon advertising?
faq.answer: No. We treat TikTok Shop ads as a complementary discovery and sales channel. Amazon remains the core growth focus for most brands we support.

faq.question: Do you publish TikTok ROAS or GMV averages?
faq.answer: No. We do not invent TikTok Shop ROAS or GMV benchmarks. Scope and success definitions are set during the free audit based on Shop readiness and creative supply.

faq.question: Which products work best on TikTok Shop?
faq.answer: Products with clear visual demos, strong hooks, and offer clarity tend to perform better. We select SKUs during the free audit.

faq.question: Do you create TikTok creative?
faq.answer: We brief and iterate creative for Shop ads and can coordinate production through our creative teams depending on scope.

faq.question: How soon can testing start?
faq.answer: Timing depends on Shop readiness, creative availability, and tracking. We confirm prerequisites before recommending spend and do not guarantee launch timelines.

faq.question: Can TikTok insights improve Amazon listings?
faq.answer: Yes. Hooks and objections that resonate on TikTok can inform Amazon listing copy, imagery, and ad angles when those workstreams are in scope.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do your brands sell in?
faq.answer: Our Amazon growth work supports official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. TikTok Shop eligibility and ad inventory vary by region; scope is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are SKU fit review, creative readiness, campaign setup, then structured testing.
